reason: A DeepSeek Harness agent preset for planning and generating standardized project skeletons from Node.js, React, Python, Go, Spring Boot, and monorepo templates, with documented file, shell, workflow, and verification capabilities.

summaries.zh: 用于根据项目需求规划并生成标准化项目骨架的 DeepSeek Harness 代理预设，提供多种技术栈模板和初始化验证流程。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness agent preset that plans and generates standardized project scaffolds from multiple technology-stack templates with an initialization and verification workflow.

capabilities: Generates project scaffolds from predefined technology-stack templates
Installs dependencies and starts projects for verification
Uses planning, workflow, skills, and sub-agent features
Can perform web searches when supported by the host profile
